gloss: yen coin (used after a denomination, e.g. 100{円玉|えんだま} "100-yen coin")

definitions.gloss: yen coin; coin of a given yen denomination
definitions.explanation: A noun used to refer to a yen coin of a specified value. Almost always preceded by a numeric denomination — the standard ones are {一円玉|いちえんだま} (¥1), {五円玉|ごえんだま} (¥5), {十円玉|じゅうえんだま} (¥10), {五十円玉|ごじゅうえんだま} (¥50), {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま} (¥100), and {五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま} (¥500). On its own, {円玉|えんだま} just means "yen coin" generically, in contrast to お{札|さつ} ("bills").

examples.japanese: {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}を{出|だ}す。
{財布|さいふ}に{五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま}が{一枚|いちまい}ある。
examples.english: I have one 500-yen coin in my wallet.

examples.japanese: {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}は{十円玉|じゅうえんだま}も{使|つか}える。
examples.english: The vending machine accepts 10-yen coins, too.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{引|ひ}き{出|だ}しを{開|あ}けたら、{何年分|なんねんぶん}もの{一円玉|いちえんだま}と{五円玉|ごえんだま}がたくさん{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: When I opened the desk drawer, years' worth of 1-yen and 5-yen coins came tumbling out.

notes:
{円玉|えんだま} is a compound of {円|えん} ("yen") and {玉|だま}/{玉|たま} ("ball, round object," a suffix used for round small objects including coins). It denotes a yen coin and is essentially always preceded by a numeric denomination, although in contrastive contexts it can stand alone (e.g. {円玉|えんだま}とお{札|さつ}, "coins and bills").

FORMS:
- {一円玉|いちえんだま}: 1-yen coin (aluminum)
- {五円玉|ごえんだま}: 5-yen coin (brass, with center hole)
- {十円玉|じゅうえんだま}: 10-yen coin (bronze)
- {五十円玉|ごじゅうえんだま}: 50-yen coin (cupronickel, with center hole)
- {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}: 100-yen coin (cupronickel)
- {五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま}: 500-yen coin (the largest in everyday circulation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}を{入|い}れる: to insert a 100-yen coin (e.g., into a vending machine)
- {五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま}を{貯|た}める: to save up 500-yen coins (a popular saving habit)
- {小銭|こぜに}と{円玉|えんだま}を{分|わ}ける: to separate coins from bills

COUNTER:
- The counter for coins as physical objects is {枚|まい} when speaking of an individual coin: {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}{一枚|いちまい} ("one 100-yen coin"). In casual speech, {個|こ} also occurs.

RELATED WORDS:
- {小銭|こぜに}: small change / coins (collective)
- {硬貨|こうか}: coin (the formal/written term, used in laws and bank language)
- お{札|さつ} / {紙幣|しへい}: paper bills
- {玉|たま} / {玉|だま}: ball, round object (used in many other compounds: {目玉|めだま} "eyeball," {水玉|みずたま} "water drop / polka dot")

USAGE:
- The reading is rendaku-shifted: {玉|たま} → だま after another element ({百円|ひゃくえん} + {玉|たま} → ひゃくえんだま).
- {円玉|えんだま} is used in everyday speech; in formal writing, banking, and legal contexts, the coin is referred to as {硬貨|こうか} (e.g., {百円硬貨|ひゃくえんこうか}).
